article.story: HOUSTON -- — Truman Claytor IV’s 25 points helped Georgia Southern defeat Houston Christian 86-79 on Thursday. Claytor had five rebounds for the Eagles (2-4). Eltramon Smith Jr. added 21 points and seven rebounds. Dallas Gardner shot 4 for 13 (0 for 3 from 3-point range) and 13 of 14 from the free-throw line to finish with 21 points. Max Alexander finished with 26 points and four assists for the Huskies (4-1). Houston Christian also got 10 points, six rebounds, three steals and three blocks from Mambourou Mara. D’Aundre Samuels also had 10 points and four assists. Up next Georgia Southern plays Monday against Northern Kentucky on the road, and Houston Christian visits UL Monroe on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
